blocks.text: 1923 mein Arthur Holly Compton ne graphite target ke dheele bandhe electrons se X-rays ke bikharne (scattering) ka mutala kiya (Fig 18.5). Unhon ne asal simt se theta zawiye par bikhri X-rays ki wavelength napi, aur dekha ke bikhri X-rays ki wavelength aane wali X-rays se zyada thi. Yeh Compton effect hai. Wavelength ka izafa classical lehar theory se samjhaya nahi ja sakta tha, is liye Compton ne tajweez kiya ke X-rays photons par mushtamil hain jin ki tawanai hc/lambda aur momentum h/lambda hai.

hf = hc/lambda tawanai wala X-ray photon rest mein electron se takrata hai, jaise billiard ki gendon ki takkar (Fig 18.6). Photon kuch tawanai electron ko de kar theta zawiye par kam tawanai hf' = hc/lambda' ke saath bikharta hai, jab ke electron phi zawiye par (m - mo)c^2 kinetic energy ke saath peeche hatta hai, jahan m chalte waqt us ki kamiyat aur mo rest kamiyat hai. Tawanai mehfooz: hf - hf' = mc^2 - moc^2, yani hc/lambda - hc/lambda' = (m - mo)c^2. Momentum dono simton mein mehfooz: asal simt mein h/lambda + 0 = (h/lambda') cos(theta) + mv cos(phi); amudi simt mein 0 = (h/lambda') sin(theta) - mv sin(phi).

In equations ko hal karne se lambda' = lambda + (h/(mo c))(1 - cos(theta)), is liye Compton shift dlambda = lambda' - lambda = (h/(mo c))(1 - cos(theta)) (18.8) hai. Factor h/(mo c) wavelength ke dimensions rakhta aur Compton wavelength kehlata hai: h/(mo c) = 6.63 x 10^-34 / (9.1 x 10^-31 x 3 x 10^8) = 2.43 x 10^-12 m. theta = 90 darje par shift Compton wavelength ke barabar hai. Equation 18.8 Compton ke nataij se poori tarah mili, jo electromagnetic lehron ke maddah se zarrati amal ki shandar tasdeeq thi. Compton ko 1927 ka Physics Nobel Prize mila.

blocks.title: Chhapi ghaltiyan
blocks.text: Kitab ki x-momentum equation mein bikhre photon ke hisse mein lambda' ki jagah lambda chhapa hai, aur shift ke baad matan ise 18.8 ki jagah 'Eq 18.6' kehta hai.

blocks.alt: Aane wala photon (purple lehar) daen chal kar rest mein electron se takrata hai. Surkh bikhra photon asal simt se theta zawiye par oopar lambi wavelength ke saath nikalta, E' = hc/lambda'; sabz peeche hatta electron phi zawiye par neeche nikalta. Neeche: Compton shift dlambda = lambda' - lambda = (h/moc)(1 - cos theta), h/moc = 2.43 x 10^-12 m, Compton wavelength.
blocks.caption: Electron se X-ray photon ki Compton scattering (Figs 18.5 aur 18.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Takkar mein photon zarre ki tarah bartao karta hai: kuch tawanai aur momentum electron ko deta hai, is liye kam tawanai aur yun lambi wavelength ke saath nikalta hai.

blocks.text: Bohat zyada tawanai wala photon, jaise gamma ray, Einstein ki tawanai ki equation ke mutabiq electron-positron jore mein badal sakta hai: photon ki tawanai = jora banane ke liye darkaar tawanai + zarrat ki K.E., ya hf = 2mo c^2 + K.E.(e-) + K.E.(e+) (18.9). Pair production ka ulat maddah ka annihilation hai, jis mein zarra aur us ka antiparticle mil kar zyada tawanai ke gamma-ray photons mein badal jate hain: e- + e+ = gamma + gamma.

blocks.alt: Baen: gamma photon nucleus ke qareeb se guzar kar oopar-daen jata electron e- aur neeche-daen jata positron e+ ban jata; hf = 2moc^2 + KE(e-) + KE(e+). Daen: electron aur positron aik doosre ki taraf aa kar mukhalif simton mein jate do gamma photons mein khatam hote, har aik 0.51 MeV jab zarrat rest mein the.
blocks.caption: Pair production aur annihilation (asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Tawanai aur kamiyat aik doosre mein badal sakte hain: kam az kam 2moc^2 (1.02 MeV) wala photon electron-positron jora bana sakta hai, aur jora wapas shuaon mein badal sakta hai.

blocks.text: Rest mein electron-positron jore ke annihilation se banne wale do photons ki wavelength maloom karein; har photon ki tawanai rest kamiyat ki tawanai, 0.51 MeV, ke barabar hai. Hal: E = 0.51 x 10^6 eV x 1.6 x 10^-19 J/eV = 8.16 x 10^-14 J. lambda = hc/E = (6.63 x 10^-34 J s x 3 x 10^8 m s^-1)/(8.16 x 10^-14 J) = 2.43 x 10^-12 m = 2.43 pm.

blocks.prompt: 180 darje par bikhri X-rays ka Compton shift kya hai?
blocks.explanation: dlambda = (h/moc)(1 - cos 180 darje) = 2 x 2.43 x 10^-12 m = 4.86 x 10^-12 m, sab se bara mumkina shift.

items: Compton effect: bikhri X-rays ki wavelength lambi.
dlambda = (h/moc)(1 - cos theta); h/moc = 2.43 x 10^-12 m.
Pair production: hf = 2moc^2 + KEs; annihilation: e- + e+ -> 2 gamma.
